generation.explanation: Arrange four identical right triangles, with legs a and b and hypotenuse c, inside a square of side a+b; the uncovered central square has area c². Slide the same triangles into two rectangular pairs, leaving two squares with total area a²+b². Because neither the outer square nor the total triangle area changes, the uncovered areas are equal: c² = a²+b².
